description: This file defines the Email validation rule class as part of a validator module within the OrangeHRM project. It extends an abstract rule class, providing a method to validate email addresses using a regular expression.

classes.name: Email
classes.description: A class that implements email validation logic using a regex pattern. It extends AbstractRule and provides a validate method.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input string is a valid email address according to the defined regex pattern or if it is an empty string; returns a boolean.
